label: RAG Ingest
info:
Islandora upload event -> fetch PDF -> POST to ragsvc /ingest -> publish status.

Environment variables (set on the nodered container or in settings.js):
  RAGSVC_URL  e.g. http://host.docker.internal:8000 (dev) or http://ragsvc:8000 (deployed)
  RAGSVC_KEY  the EMBEDDING_API_KEY shared secret

Drupal side: create a Context/Action that publishes media-create events to
queue 'islandora-connector-rag' (same pattern as the existing islandora-connector-* actions).

name: extract file URL + auth
